title: Three Shifts and One Short Switch
subtitle: 网络信息 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 网络信息（人与社会·科学与技术·网络与信息）
meta: 主题语境：网络信息（人与社会·科学与技术·网络与信息）　|　核心词汇：recording　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 recording 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1981 the operator ① made the recording that no trainee in the station would have described, and he said the making was the whole of the shift. The ② recording, meaning the tape itself and not the switch, ran three shifts and stayed undescribed in the book; a recording, he said, is the only thing in a station that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ recording in that station had the same short switch beside it, and the ④ recording at the far screen, meaning the cable they kept for the children to check and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A recording, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the operator said the describing is the part that fills three shifts.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the recording was the whole of the matter, meaning the memory and not the tape. The ⑥ recording, meaning the memory and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; recording, he said, is either something you make or the only word that means both a tape and a memory. He said the memory is the part they remember.

By 1986 the ⑦ recording had become a line in a log, and the log had become an argument about the short switch. The ⑧ recording of the whole thing, the operator wrote in June, was one station and three shifts of describing; recording, he said, is either the cable at the far screen or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ recording I remember is the tape described in the log, which closed in 1988 and is still described as the quietest in the station. A ⑩ recording, my mother said in 1990, is the only tape that improves by being described; every recording, she said, is a memory that has agreed to look like a tape. She said the memory was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 录音；录制（指机房里每一段旁边的那一段）
B. n. 录音；录制（指那段录音本身，与小小的开关相对）
C. 固定搭配：make the recording 录这一段录音
D. n. 录音；录制（指留给孩子们查的那一根）
E. n. 录音之事（抽象总称，指一处机房的录音之事）
F. n. 录音；录制（指运行日志里写到、被描述的那一段）
G. n. 录音、留存（指一件事里人人都按却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 留存（抽象总称，指人人都按却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: made the recording that no trainee in the station would have described
The recording, meaning the tape itself and not the switch
the recording at the far screen
the recording was the whole of the matter
the recording had become a line in a log
The recording of the whole thing
A recording, my mother said in 1990

answers.why: make the recording 意为“录这一段录音”，1981 年那位操作员把机房里没有一位实习生肯描述的一段录音做了一遍。
recording 意为“录音；录制”，指那段录音本身而不是小小的开关，它经过了三个班次而在簿子上没有被描述。
recording 意为“录音；录制”，指机房里每一段旁边的那一段，每一段旁边都有同一个小小的开关。
recording 意为“录音；录制”，指最远那块屏幕的留给孩子们查的那一根，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
recording 意为“录音、留存”，指一件事里人人都按却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这段留存就是那件事的全部。
recording 意为“留存”，指人人都按却无人提起的那样东西而不是那段录音，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
recording 意为“录音；录制”，指运行日志里写到、被描述的那一段，到 1986 年这一段成了运行日志里的一行。
recording 意为“录音之事”，操作员六月写道，整件事的录音之事是一处机房和三个班次的描述。
recording 意为“录音；录制”，我记得的是运行日志里描述过的那一段，1988 年调好了，至今仍被说成机房里最安静的一段。
recording 为抽象总称，母亲 1990 年说，录音是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的录音。

task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1981 年那位操作员录了机房里没有一位实习生肯描述的一段录音，他说这一遍才是那个班次的全部。（make the recording）
那段录音，指的是那段录音本身而不是小小的开关，经过了三个班次而在簿子上没有被描述。（recording）
那处机房里每一段录音旁边都有同一个小小的开关。（recording）
最远那块屏幕那段录音，指的是他们留给孩子们查的那一根，是唯一有人谢过两次的。（recording）
叔叔说这段留存就是那件事的全部，指的是那样东西而不是那段录音。（recording）
1990 年母亲说，录音是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的录音。（recording）
